outcome: short-term postoperative complications (≤ 3 months, e.g., infection, hematoma, pain, voiding dysfunction)
long-term re-operations (up to 6 years, e.g., for infections, persistent SUI, tape revision)
urinary incontinence symptoms (measured by ICIQ-UI SF and PGI-I)
cohort: The study included 446 women with stress urinary incontinence who underwent TVT operation between 2012 and 2016 at a tertiary referral center.
finding: The tension-free vaginal tape (TVT) operation demonstrated high safety and efficacy with only minor short-term complications, few long-term re-operations, and a significant reduction in urinary incontinence symptoms.
